journey.name: EXC-03: 权限拒绝降级场景
journey.description: 验证用户在附件选择过程中拒绝相机或存储权限时，应用能够优雅拦截 SecurityException，通过 Toast 或内嵌横幅提示权限缺失，并保持当前工作台上下文完好，不闪退、不丢失草稿。

actions.action: Verify that the workbench composer input is visible
Verify that the attachment bottom sheet is displayed
Verify that if camera permission is rejected the app returns safely to workbench
Verify that the composer input remains interactive
Verify that no unhandled crash occurred
